# Differences between this library and System.Xml.Schema (XSD 1.0)

This document lists every difference that the differential run over the W3C XML Schema Test Suite (XSTS) cases of XSD 1.0 finds between this library and `System.Xml.Schema`, the XSD 1.0 implementation of the .NET base class library. Each difference is classified: this library follows the specification (a deviation from the baseline), the observation is equivalent (only issue positions differ), or this library is wrong (a bug issue that the known-failures lists of the XSTS tests track).

| | |
|---|---|
| Baseline | `System.Xml.Schema` of the .NET runtime 10.0, compared on the `net10.0` test leg only (`baseline-runtime: 10.0`) |
| Corpus | XSTS cases of XSD 1.0 (schema tests and instance tests), pinned in `tests/conformance/suites/xsts.json` |
| Data file | `tests/NetEvolve.Schemas.Xsd.Tests.Integration/DifferentialData/xsts-1.0-deviations.txt`, one entry per difference: case id, difference kind, observed difference, specification reference, reason |
| Entries | 14585 entries for 14548 cases |

The list is valid for the recorded baseline runtime version only. A run on another runtime version fails until the list is compared again. System.Xml.Schema implements XSD 1.0 only, so cases of XSD 1.1 are not compared.

## How a difference is classified

The differential run reads every schema and instance case of XSD 1.0 with this library and with the baseline and compares the verdicts and the positions of the reported issues (messages are never compared). Every difference ends in exactly one of three ways.

1. **This library follows the specification.** The XSTS expectation of the case matches this library and not the baseline. The difference has an entry in the data file with a specification reference and a reason; the sections of verdict differences below group them.
2. **The difference is equivalent.** Both engines agree on the verdict and report issues at other positions or in another number. The specification defines no issue positions, so the entry records the observed positions as an accepted difference.
3. **This library is wrong.** The case is a known failure of the schema tests or the instance tests with a bug issue. It has no entry here: its differences to the baseline are symptoms of that defect and are tracked by the issue. A case leaves this set when its issue is fixed and the case leaves the known-failures list; every difference that is left on it then needs an entry of its own. The differential run excludes these cases, so no difference stays unexplained.

A known failure without a bug issue is a documented limitation of this library: a design decision (DP-3 and DP-16 of design #146), a resource limit, or a left-out function with its own issue (#956). Its differences have entries; see the section of documented limitations.

No builder option, switch, or code path in the library reproduces System.Xml.Schema behavior; a compatibility mode is tracked separately (DEF-77, #89).

## Summary

| Class | Entries | Cases |
|---|---:|---:|
| Verdict differences: this library follows the specification | 1696 | 1664 |
| Verdict differences: documented limitations of this library | 26 | 21 |
| Position differences: equivalent | 12868 | 12868 |
| Differences on cases that a bug issue tracks (no entry) | 943 | |

## Differences on cases that a bug issue tracks

The known-failures lists `tests/NetEvolve.Schemas.Xsd.Tests.Integration/SchemaTests/known-failures.txt` and `tests/NetEvolve.Schemas.Xsd.Tests.Integration/InstanceTests/known-failures.txt` record every case of XSD 1.0 that this library does not pass yet, each with its bug issue. At the time of this triage the run found 9990 differences on these cases:

| Issue | Differences | Title |
|---|---:|---|
| #1077 | 654 | feat(xsd): evaluate the enumeration facet of list simple types in the value space |
| #1078 | 101 | feat(xsd): evaluate the enumeration facet of union simple types in the value space |
| #963 | 35 | test(conformance): run the xsts instance tests of groups without a schema document through schema location hints |
| #869 | 23 | feat(xsd): check redefinitions against the redefined component |
| #870 | 22 | feat(xsd): add notation declarations as components |
| #874 | 22 | bug(xsd): schema constraints that the pipeline does not check yet |
| #62 | 19 | feat(xml): support xml 1.1 |
| #1127 | 18 | bug(xsd): a derived attribute wildcard is rejected against the intersection of the attribute group wildcards |
| #863 | 17 | bug(xsd): particle restriction reports errors for restrictions that the XSTS accepts |
| #896 | 7 | feat(xsd): compare fixed values in the value space when validating instances |
| #602 | 6 | feat(xsd): apply default values to elements with mixed content |
| #871 | 5 | feat(xsd): reject a value constraint on an attribute or element of type ID |
| #1080 | 4 | fix(xml): match every XML name character with the multi-character escape c in the pattern facet |
| #1079 | 3 | feat(xsd): evaluate the enumeration facet of hexBinary and base64Binary restrictions |
| #604 | 2 | feat(xsd): resolve QName and NOTATION instance values with the namespace context |
| #1129 | 2 | bug(xsd): an import of a document with the namespace of the importing schema reports duplicate declarations |
| #410 | 1 | feat(xml): support caller-selectable xml 1.1 name productions |
| #1128 | 1 | bug(xsd): an import whose schema location cannot be resolved is reported as an error |
| #1130 | 1 | bug(xsd): a targetNamespace attribute with an empty value is accepted |

## Verdict differences: this library follows the specification

### A pattern outside the XSD regular expression grammar

The pattern is not a regular expression of the XSD grammar, so the schema is invalid. System.Xml.Schema accepts it.

- Difference: SchemaVerdict `schema verdict: ours=Invalid, baseline=Valid` (498)
- Specification: XSD 1.0 Part 2, 4.3.4 (pattern) and F (Regular Expressions)
- Cases: 498

## Verdict differences: documented limitations of this library

Both engines reject the document with the same number of issues, and the verdicts agree. They attribute the issues to different constructs of the document. Issue positions are not part of the specification, so the difference is equivalent.

- Difference: IssuePositions `issue positions` (8564)

### The baseline throws while it loads the schema

Both engines reject the schema. System.Xml.Schema throws an ArgumentException (an empty string for a name) while it loads the schema, so the baseline reports no position. The baseline adapter maps the exception to an invalid schema without positions.

- Difference: IssuePositions `issue positions` (21)
- Specification: XSD 1.0 Part 1, 5.1 (a schema document must be valid against the schema for schemas, A)

## Limitations

- The list is valid for the baseline runtime version in its header only.
- System.Xml.Schema implements XSD 1.0 only; XSD 1.1 behavior has no baseline and the cases of XSD 1.1 are not compared.
- The comparison covers verdicts and the positions of reported issues. Messages are never compared.
- The XSTS expectation of a case is the reference for the classification. A case that the XSTS marks otherwise than accepted is outside the selection and outside this list.
- Defects found by this triage are fixed in their own issues, not in this document or in the data file. The baseline throws an ArgumentException for 21 schemas; the adapter maps it to an invalid schema without positions.
